title: Nai Duniya Naye Log
overview: Sophistication is the dominant factor in the present day life of the people belonging to upper  strata of Society. Parents belonging to upper strata of Society have their own lives to lead. They hardly have time to attend to their children. Children are left to the care of the servants. Bonds of relationship between parents and children, when they grow up, do not exist at all.

songs.title: Ae Pyar Mujhe Ro Lene De
Mujhe Teri Bahon Mein Na Jane
Do Honth Hile Ek Geet Suna
